_comment: Probe set for AC01 (language) and AC02 (intent routing).
DATA, not code, for the same reason evaluation/questions.json is: a
different deployment brings its own vocabulary and language mix.
`language` is the expected verdict: ar | en | mixed | unsupported |
undetermined. `route` is the expected intent slug, where
'general_retrieval' means 'tier 2 decides' — for out-of-scope, write and
cross-project probes that is the CURRENT expectation, deliberately, and
the probe records how many of them land there rather than asserting they
`note` is free text for the reader; nothing reads it.
